theme: 全真模擬考 第 1 回

words.ex: You can withdraw from a course before week four.
Remember to cite your sources correctly.
Plagiarism can lead to a failing grade.
All users must comply with the lab rules.
The club found sponsorship from a local bank.
Please notify the office if you cannot attend.
She did a summer internship at a software company.
The application asks for two recommendation letters.
There is a waiting list of over fifty people.
The gym is crowded during peak hours.
The room inspection is on Wednesday.
The express bus does not stop at the library.

audio.t: Excuse me, do you know when the library closes tonight?

options: It closes at ten thirty on weekdays.
I borrowed three books last night.
Yes, the library card is free.
questions.explain: 問圖書館今晚幾點關門，(A) 直接回答關門時間。(B) 重複 library／night 但答非所問；(C) 用 Yes 回答 When 問句，且談的是借書證。

audio.t: Have you registered for the career fair next week?

options: Thanks, I'm feeling much better now.
Not yet. Is there still time?
questions.explain: 問是否已報名下週的就業博覽會，(C)「還沒，還來得及嗎？」最自然。(A) 用過去式描述博覽會，時間不符；(B) fair 與 feeling 混淆，答非所問。

audio.t: Why don't we study together for the statistics exam?

options: Statistics is in room two oh five.
questions.explain: Why don't we...? 是提議，不是問原因，(B) 接受並提出時間。(A) 誤把它當成問「為什麼」而用 Because 回答；(C) 只重複 statistics。

audio.t: Who's in charge of booking the room for the club meeting?

options: I think Jenny is handling it.
It costs nothing to join the club.
questions.explain: 問誰負責借社團開會的教室，(B) 回答人名。(A) 談會議長度；(C) charge 有「收費」之意，誘答談費用，但題目的 in charge of 是「負責」。

audio.t: Would you mind lending me your lecture notes from Monday?

options: Not at all. I'll email them to you.
questions.explain: Would you mind...? 回答 Not at all 表示「不介意、可以」，(A) 正確。(B) 重複 mind 和 lecture；(C) 只抓 Monday，且與借筆記無關。

audio.t: How long does it take to get to the science building from here?

options: It was built about ten years ago.
Take the long way, it's prettier.
questions.explain: How long does it take 問所需時間，(C) 走路約十五分鐘。(A) 回答建築年代；(B) 重複 long，但沒回答需要多久。

audio.t: Isn't the deadline for the scholarship application this Friday?

options: I applied for a part-time job.
No, it's been extended to next Monday.
questions.explain: 否定問句確認截止日是否為週五，(C) 說明已延到下週一。(A) 只談獎學金內容；(B) applied 與 application 字形相近，但談的是打工。

audio.t: Where should I return this laptop I borrowed from the media center?

options: Just bring it to the front desk on the second floor.
questions.explain: 問筆電要還到哪裡，(B) 給出地點。(A) 重複 laptop 但描述性能；(C) 重複 return，但是「回家」。

audio.t: The dorm's hot water has been off since this morning.

options: Yes, maintenance says it'll be fixed by tonight.
I prefer cold drinks in summer.
The dorm is next to the gym.
questions.explain: 對方抱怨宿舍熱水從早上就停了，(A) 附和並說明維修進度。(B) 用 hot／cold 聯想誘答；(C) 只重複 dorm。

audio.t: Should I take Professor Lin's writing class or the one in the evening?

options: Professor Lin's class gives more feedback, I've heard.
I wrote it in the evening.
The class was full of energy.
questions.explain: 選擇疑問句問要選林教授的課還是晚上的課，(A) 給出建議與理由。(B) writing／wrote、evening 重複字誘答；(C) 描述某堂課的氣氛，沒有回答選擇。

audio.t: What did you think of the guest speaker's talk?

options: It was inspiring, though a bit long.
questions.explain: 問對演講的看法，(C) 表達感想。(A) 用未來式說演講時間，時態與問題不符；(B) talk／talked 重複字誘答。

audio.t: Could you tell me how to reset my campus email password?

options: My email address is on the card.
You can do it on the IT services website.
questions.explain: 問如何重設校園信箱密碼，(B) 指出可到資訊服務網站處理。(A) 重複 email；(C) 重複 reset，內容無關。

audio.t: Hi, I need to print my thesis, but the printer in the library keeps jamming.
The one on the first floor is out of order. Try the printers in the computer lab on the third floor. They're faster anyway.
Do I need to pay there?
Yes, but you can use your student card. It's two dollars for fifty pages.

questions.prompt: Where will the woman most likely go next?
options: The first floor of the library
The computer lab on the third floor
questions.explain: 男子建議改去三樓電腦教室的印表機，故選 (B)。(A) 一樓的印表機故障；(C) 學生證只是付款方式，不必去辦公室；(D) 對話未提到校外影印店。

audio.t: Attention, students. Due to heavy rain, all outdoor physical education classes this afternoon will be moved to the indoor sports center. Please bring indoor shoes. Classes will start fifteen minutes later than usual to give everyone time to move.

questions.prompt: What are students asked to do?
questions.explain: 廣播明確要求 Please bring indoor shoes，選 (A)。(B) 課程是移到室內，不是取消；(C) 是「晚」十五分鐘開始，不是提早到。

audio.t: Hey, are you going to the international food festival on Saturday?
I want to, but I have a shift at the café until three.
No problem. It runs until eight in the evening. Most of the booths open at noon, but the cooking show starts at four.
Perfect, then I can catch that.

questions.prompt: What will the woman probably do on Saturday?
options: Watch the cooking show after work
Arrive at the festival at noon
questions.explain: 女子在咖啡店上班到三點，烹飪秀四點開始，她說 I can catch that，故選 (C)。(A) 她是在咖啡店打工，不是在攤位；(B) 她會去；(D) 中午她還在上班。

audio.t: Hi Kevin, this is Grace from the housing office. We received your request to change rooms. A single room in Building C is available from next month, but it's thirty dollars more per month. Please come to the office by Wednesday to sign the form if you still want it.

questions.prompt: Why did Grace call?
options: To ask Kevin to pay a late fee
To tell Kevin about an available room
To report a problem in Building C
questions.explain: Grace 回覆換房申請，告知 C 棟有單人房可住，選 (B)。(A) 多付的三十元是房租差額，不是滯納金；(C) C 棟只是空房的位置，沒有問題要回報。

audio.t: Before you leave, a quick note about your group presentations. Each group has ten minutes, plus five minutes for questions. Please send me your slides by midnight the day before. If your slides arrive late, your group will lose points, so don't wait until the last minute.

questions.prompt: What happens if a group sends its slides late?
options: The group gets a lower score
questions.explain: your group will lose points 即被扣分，選 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 都是利用談話中的「十分鐘、五分鐘提問」等細節誘答，並非遲交的後果。

audio.t: I'm thinking of dropping my economics course. I'm really behind.
Before you do, have you tried the free tutoring center? My friend went there twice a week and passed with a B.
I didn't know it was free. I'll check it out.

questions.prompt: What does the man suggest?
questions.explain: 男子建議先去免費的課輔中心，選 (C)。(A) 他的朋友只是成功例子，並非要她跟朋友讀書；(B) 退選是女子自己的想法，男子勸她先別退。

audio.t: Good news for cyclists: starting next Monday, the university will open a new bike parking area behind the Student Union. It has room for three hundred bikes and is covered, so your bike stays dry. The old parking area near the main gate will close for construction.

questions.prompt: What is true about the new parking area?
options: It is near the main gate.
questions.explain: is covered, so your bike stays dry 表示有屋頂，選 (D)。(A) 靠近校門的是要關閉的舊停車場；(B) 下週一啟用；(C) 可停三百台，不是兩百台。

audio.t: Excuse me, is this the line for picking up graduation gowns?
No, this is for buying tickets for the ceremony. Gowns are picked up in the gym, next to the basketball court.

questions.prompt: What does the man want to do?
questions.explain: 男子問這是不是領畢業袍的隊伍，可知他想領畢業袍，選 (A)。(B) 買典禮票是這條隊伍的用途，不是他的目的；(C) 籃球場只是位置參考。

audio.t: Welcome to the campus tour. We'll start here at the library, then visit the engineering building and the art museum. Lunch is in the main dining hall at twelve thirty. Please stay with the group, and if you get lost, call the number on your map.

questions.prompt: Where will the group have lunch?
questions.explain: Lunch is in the main dining hall，選 (D)。(A)(B)(C) 都是導覽路線上會參觀的地點，但不是用餐處。

audio.t: My lab partner hasn't replied to my messages for a week, and our report is due Thursday.
That's frustrating. Maybe talk to the teaching assistant. She can help sort it out or let you finish it alone.

questions.prompt: What is the man's problem?
options: His lab partner is not responding.
The teaching assistant gave him a low grade.
questions.explain: 男子說實驗夥伴一週沒回訊息，選 (A)。(B) 報告是週四要交，並沒有遺失；(C) 助教是女子建議求助的對象，沒有打分數。

audio.t: This is a reminder from the study abroad office. The information session on exchange programs in Japan and Korea has been moved from room three ten to the lecture hall on the ground floor, because more than eighty students have signed up. The session still begins at six p.m.

questions.prompt: Why was the session moved?
options: Room three ten is being repaired.
questions.explain: because more than eighty students have signed up 說明報名人數多，選 (B)。(A) 時間仍是六點不變；(C) 沒提到教室維修；(D) 說明會照常舉行。

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone. I'm Diane Ho from the university library. Today I want to introduce our new Research Help Desk, which opened this semester.
If you are writing a term paper or a thesis, our librarians can help you find academic articles, choose good search words, and cite your sources correctly.
You can book a thirty-minute appointment online, or simply drop in between one and five p.m. on weekdays.

Many students think the service is only for graduate students, but in fact anyone, including first-year students, is welcome. Last semester, students who used the desk at least twice reported that they saved several hours on each assignment.
One more thing: from next month, we will also offer online sessions through video chat, so you don't even need to come to the library.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the talk?
options: To announce new library opening hours
To introduce a research support service
To explain how to write a thesis
questions.explain: 講者開頭就說要介紹新的 Research Help Desk，選 (B)。(A) 「一點到五點」只是服務時段，不是新的開館時間；(C) 論文只是服務對象的例子；(D) 沒有招募人員。

questions.prompt: What can librarians help students with? (Choose TWO.)
questions.explain: 講者提到館員能幫忙 find academic articles、choose good search words、cite your sources correctly，故選 (A)(C)。(B) 修改文法、(D) 繳罰款、(E) 印海報都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What will change next month?
options: The desk will close on weekends.
Only graduate students can use it.
questions.explain: from next month, we will also offer online sessions through video chat，選 (C)。(A) 原本就只在平日；(B) 預約仍為三十分鐘；(D) 講者強調所有學生都可使用。

audio.t: Hi, Ms. Chen. I'd like to ask about the summer internship program.
Sure, Daniel. Which company are you interested in?
There's a marketing position at a software company in Taipei. But the application asks for two recommendation letters, and I only have one.
You could ask the professor of your business writing class. She's written letters for many students.
Good idea. Also, the internship is unpaid. Can I still get course credit for it?
Yes. If you work at least two hundred hours, you'll receive three credits. You'll need to write a short report at the end, though.
Two hundred hours... that's about five weeks full-time. That works. When's the deadline?
The company's deadline is April fifth, but our office needs your credit form one week before that.

questions.prompt: What problem does the man have with his application?
options: He cannot find the company's address.
He needs one more recommendation letter.
questions.explain: 申請需要兩封推薦信，他只有一封，選 (D)。(B) 截止日還沒到；(A)(C) 對話中沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What must the man do to get course credit?
options: Pay a fee to the office
Work at least 200 hours and write a report
Get a letter from the company
questions.explain: 陳老師說工作滿兩百小時可得三學分，最後還要寫一份簡短報告，選 (B)。(C) 商業寫作課是推薦信老師的課，不是學分條件；(A)(D) 未提到。

questions.prompt: When must the man submit the credit form?
questions.explain: 公司截止日是四月五日，學校辦公室要在一週前收到學分表格，即三月二十九日，選 (C)。(D) 是公司的截止日，是主要干擾選項。

audio.t: This is Campus Voice with your weekly news. The Student Union has released the results of its survey on campus dining. More than one thousand two hundred students responded.
The biggest complaint was long lines at lunchtime, mentioned by about sixty percent of students. Price came second, and the lack of vegetarian choices came third.
In response, the dining hall will open a second serving counter from eleven thirty to one thirty starting next week. It will also add three new vegetarian dishes to the daily menu.
Prices, however, will stay the same for now, because food costs have been rising. The Student Union says it will run another survey at the end of the semester to see whether things have improved.

questions.prompt: What was the students' most common complaint?
questions.explain: The biggest complaint was long lines at lunchtime，選 (D)。(B) 價格排第二；(A) 素食選擇少排第三；(C) 未提到。

questions.prompt: What changes will the dining hall make? (Choose TWO.)
questions.explain: 餐廳將開第二個供餐窗口並新增三道素食，選 (B)(D)。(A) 價格暫時維持不變；(C)(E) 都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What will the Student Union do at the end of the semester?
options: Close the dining hall for repairs
questions.explain: it will run another survey at the end of the semester，選 (A)。(B)(C)(D) 都沒有提到。

audio.t: Today we're looking at how sleep affects learning. Many of you probably stay up late before an exam, reading your notes again and again. But research shows this may not be the best strategy.

During deep sleep, the brain replays what we learned during the day and moves it into long-term memory. In one well-known study, students who slept eight hours after learning a list of words remembered about twenty percent more the next day than students who stayed awake. Interestingly, even a short nap of around twenty minutes helped a little.
So what does this mean for you? Spread your study over several days, and protect your sleep, especially the night before a test.
For next week, please read chapter six, which looks at how stress affects memory.

questions.prompt: What is the lecture mainly about?
options: Why naps are better than night sleep
The link between sleep and memory
Ways to read notes more quickly
questions.explain: 開頭 how sleep affects learning，全篇談睡眠如何幫助記憶，選 (C)。(A) 講者只說小睡「有一點幫助」，沒說比夜間睡眠好；(B) 壓力是下週閱讀的主題；(D) 未談讀得更快。

questions.prompt: According to the study, how much more did the students who slept remember?
questions.explain: 研究中睡了八小時的學生隔天多記住約百分之二十，選 (A)。(B) 的「八」來自「睡八小時」，是數字干擾。

questions.prompt: What are students asked to do for next week?
options: Take a short nap before class
Read a chapter about stress and memory
Write a report on the study
questions.explain: please read chapter six, which looks at how stress affects memory，選 (B)。(A) 小睡是研究內容，不是作業；(C)(D) 未提到。

questions.prompt: Students who wish to ______ from a course must do so before the end of the fourth week.
questions.explain: withdraw from a course 是「退選課程」的固定用法，選 (A)。withhold 扣留、withstand 承受，都不接 from a course；undertake 承擔，語意不合。

questions.prompt: The professor asked us to ______ our sources at the end of the essay so readers can find them.
questions.explain: cite sources 指「註明引用資料來源」，選 (B)。site（地點）與 cite 同音是主要陷阱；sigh 嘆氣、recite 背誦，皆不合語意。

questions.prompt: Because of the ______ number of applicants, the dormitory cannot offer rooms to all first-year students.
questions.explain: 宿舍無法提供所有新生房間，表示申請人數「多到應付不來」，選 (C) overwhelming。(A)(B)(D) 都表示人數少或減少，與後半句矛盾。

questions.prompt: Please keep your receipt as ______ of payment in case there is a problem with your registration.
questions.explain: as proof of payment「作為付款證明」，需要名詞 proof，選 (D)。prove 是動詞、proven 是過去分詞；approval 是名詞但意為「核准」，語意不符。

questions.prompt: The seminar was so ______ that many students stayed afterward to ask the speaker questions.
questions.explain: 學生會後留下來發問，表示研討會「引人入勝」，選 (C) engaging。(D) engaged 用來形容人「投入的」，不能修飾 seminar；(A)(B) 與後句結果矛盾。

questions.prompt: All laboratory users must ______ with the safety rules posted on the door.
questions.explain: comply with 是「遵守」的固定搭配，選 (A)。obey、follow、respect 雖然意思接近，但都是及物動詞，後面不加 with。

questions.prompt: The student club received a ______ from a local company to cover the cost of its trip.
questions.explain: 企業提供經費支付旅行費用，是「贊助」sponsorship，選 (D)。refund 是退還已付的錢；penalty 罰款、debt 債務，語意不合。

questions.prompt: If you are unable to attend the interview, please ______ the office at least 24 hours in advance.
questions.explain: notify + 受詞「通知某人／單位」，選 (B)。inform 後不加 to；tell about 少了受詞；announce 是「公開宣布」，不接人或單位當受詞。

questions.prompt: The final exam will ______ all the chapters we have studied since the midterm.
questions.explain: cover 有「涵蓋（範圍）」之意，選 (D)。consist 須接 of；include 不加 in；contain 不加 of，三者皆為文法錯誤。

questions.prompt: Free counseling is ______ to all students, regardless of their year or major.
questions.explain: be available to + 人「提供給某人使用」，選 (C)。able、capable 形容人有能力；accessible 應接 to，不接 of。

questions.prompt: Tom's essay was rejected because it was too similar to an article online; the teacher suspected ______.
questions.explain: 文章與網路文章太相似，老師懷疑「抄襲」plagiarism，選 (A)。其他三個字同樣以 -ism 結尾，是字形干擾。

questions.prompt: Exchange students should ______ for a visa at least two months before departure.
questions.explain: apply for a visa「申請簽證」，選 (B)。supply 供應、reply 回覆、imply 暗示，都是 -ply 結尾的字形干擾。

reading.title: Room Safety Inspection
head: From: Residence Life Office
To: All residents of Maple Hall
Subject: Room Safety Inspection – November 12
passage: Dear residents, our annual room safety inspection will take place on Wednesday, November 12, between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m. Staff will check smoke detectors, electrical outlets, and windows. You do not need to be present, but please make sure the floor near your outlets is clear.

Please note that cooking appliances such as rice cookers and hot plates are not allowed in rooms. Any such items found will be held at the front desk and can be collected at the end of the semester. If you have questions, reply to this email by November 10.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?
options: To ask residents to clean their rooms
questions.explain: 信件主旨是通知年度宿舍安全檢查的時間與內容，選 (B)。(A) 只要求插座附近地板淨空，並非打掃整間房；(C)(D) 未提到。

questions.prompt: What will happen to a rice cooker found in a room?
options: The resident must pay a fine.
It will be kept until the semester ends.
It will be returned the next day.
questions.explain: 違規電器會被暫放在櫃台，學期末才能領回，選 (C)。(A)(B) 信中未說丟棄或罰款；(D) 不是隔天歸還。

reading.title: Text Messages
passage: Amy (2:05 p.m.): Hey, are you still coming to the group meeting at four? We moved it to the library's second floor because the café is too noisy.
Ben (2:12 p.m.): Yes, but my bus is running late. I might be fifteen minutes behind. Can you start without me?
Amy (2:14 p.m.): Sure. Just make sure you bring the survey data. We can't finish the charts without it.
Ben (2:15 p.m.): Got it. I've already saved it on my laptop.

questions.prompt: Why was the meeting place changed?
questions.explain: Amy 說 because the café is too noisy，選 (D)。(A) 公車誤點是 Ben 會遲到的原因，不是換地點的原因；(B) 他們正是改到圖書館；(C) 未提到。

questions.prompt: What does Amy ask Ben to bring?
questions.explain: Amy 要 Ben 帶 survey data，選 (A)。(B) 圖表是要用資料「完成」的東西，不是要他帶來；(C)(D) 未提到。

reading.title: Campus Fitness Center: New Rules from December 1
passage: To reduce crowding during peak hours (5–8 p.m.), the Fitness Center will introduce a booking system. Students must reserve a 60-minute time slot through the campus app before visiting. Walk-in visits will only be accepted outside peak hours.
Also, towels will no longer be provided free of charge. Users may bring their own or rent one at the front desk for NT$10. Lockers remain free, but items left overnight will be removed.

questions.prompt: When must students book a time slot?
questions.explain: 預約制是為了減少尖峰時段（下午五點到八點）的人潮，尖峰以外可直接入場，選 (C)。(A) 非尖峰不需預約；(B) 未提週末；(D) 十二月一日是新制開始日。

questions.prompt: What is NOT free from December 1?
questions.explain: 毛巾不再免費提供，租用要 NT$10，選 (A)。(B) Lockers remain free；(C)(D) 文中沒有說要收費。

reading.title: Photography Club – Membership Application
head: Name: Lisa Wang
Student ID: 411230057
Department: Chinese Literature, Year 2
passage: Membership type (check one): [ ] Regular (NT$500 per semester)  [X] Regular + Equipment (NT$800 per semester, includes camera rental)
Experience level: [X] Beginner  [ ] Intermediate  [ ] Advanced
Preferred workshop day: Thursday evening
Comments: I don't own a camera yet, so I would like to borrow one. I'm also interested in helping with the spring exhibition.

questions.prompt: How much will Lisa pay this semester?
questions.explain: Lisa 勾選含器材的方案，每學期 NT$800（已包含相機租借），選 (C)。(B) 是一般會員價；(D) 是把兩種價格相加的陷阱；(A) 是兩者差額。

questions.prompt: What does Lisa say in her comments?
options: She wants to sell her camera.
She would like to help with an exhibition.
questions.explain: 備註寫 interested in helping with the spring exhibition，選 (B)。(A) 她還沒有相機；(C) 她勾選初學者；(D) 她偏好的正是週四晚上。

reading.title: Part-Time Job: Writing Center Assistant
passage: The University Writing Center is looking for two student assistants for the spring semester. Assistants will greet visitors, schedule appointments, and help organize workshops. Applicants should have strong English skills and be available at least ten hours per week.

The position pays NT$200 per hour. Previous office experience is helpful but not required. To apply, send your résumé and a short writing sample to writingcenter@univ.edu by January 5. Interviews will be held in the second week of January.

questions.prompt: What is one duty of the assistant?
questions.explain: 工作內容包含 schedule appointments，選 (A)。(B)(C) 雖與寫作中心相關，但文中只要求英文能力好，沒說要教課或批改；(D) 未提到。

questions.prompt: What is required to apply?
questions.explain: 申請須寄履歷與一份 short writing sample，選 (B)。(A) 有經驗是加分但 not required；(C) 未提到；(D) 要求是每週至少十小時。

reading.title: Students Turn Unused Campus Land into a Community Garden
passage: Last spring, a group of environmental science students noticed that a piece of land behind the Agriculture Building had been empty for years. Led by third-year student Kevin Lu, they asked the university for permission to turn it into a community garden. After two months of discussion, the university agreed, on the condition that the students manage the garden themselves and keep it tidy.

Today, the garden has thirty small plots. Any student or staff member can rent one for NT$300 per semester. The money is used to buy seeds, tools, and a water tank that collects rainwater. Members must spend at least two hours a week working in the garden, and those who fail to do so for a month may lose their plot.

The garden has become more popular than anyone expected. There is currently a waiting list of over fifty people. Kevin says the biggest benefit is not the vegetables but the friendships. "Students from different departments who would never meet in class now share tools and advice," he explains.
The team now hopes to double the size of the garden next year. However, the university has said that part of the land may be needed for a new parking lot, so the plan is still uncertain.

questions.prompt: What condition did the university set?
options: The students must pay rent to the university.
The students must take care of the garden themselves.
Only environmental science students could join.
The garden had to be finished in two months.
questions.explain: 學校同意的條件是 the students manage the garden themselves and keep it tidy，選 (B)。(A) 租金是會員付給菜園的；(C) 師生都可租；(D)「兩個月」是討論時間，是時間錯置的干擾。

questions.prompt: What is the rental fee used for?
options: Buying supplies such as seeds and tools
questions.explain: 租金用來買種子、工具和雨水收集桶，選 (D)。(C) 停車場是校方可能的土地用途，與租金無關；(A)(B) 未提到。

questions.prompt: According to Kevin, what is the greatest benefit of the garden?
questions.explain: Kevin 說最大的好處不是蔬菜而是友誼，不同科系的學生因此認識，選 (C)。(D) 雨水收集只是設備；(A)(B) 未提到。

questions.prompt: Why is the expansion plan uncertain?
options: The land may be used for parking.
questions.explain: 校方表示部分土地可能要蓋停車場，選 (A)。(B) 與事實相反，候補名單超過五十人；(C)(D) 未提到。

reading.title: My Semester in Germany: What I Wish I Had Known
passage: When I arrived in Leipzig last September for my exchange semester, I thought my biggest challenge would be the language. I had studied German for a year and could order food and ask for directions. What I did not expect was how different the classes would be.

In Taiwan, most of my courses had a midterm, a final, and regular homework. In Germany, many courses had only one final exam or one long paper at the end. There were no weekly reminders, so I had to plan my own reading schedule. In the first month I fell behind, and I only caught up after a classmate showed me how she divided the reading list week by week.

Another surprise was paperwork. Within two weeks of arrival, every student had to register their address at the city office. Appointments were hard to get, so I waited almost ten days. Without the registration, I could not open a bank account, which meant I paid my rent late in the first month.

My advice to future exchange students is simple: book official appointments before you leave home, and from the first week, treat each course as a long project rather than a series of small tasks. And don't be afraid to ask local students for help. Most of them were happy to explain how things worked.

questions.prompt: What did the writer find unexpected about studying in Germany?
questions.explain: 作者說原以為語言最難，沒想到課程差異很大：多數課只有一次期末考或一篇報告，選 (D)。(B) 是作者「原本預期」的挑戰，是主要干擾；(A)(C) 未提到。

questions.prompt: How did the writer catch up with the reading?
options: By asking the professor for an extension
By following a classmate's weekly plan
By studying with a tutor in Taiwan
questions.explain: 一位同學教作者把閱讀清單按週分配後才趕上進度，選 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 文中都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: Why did the writer pay rent late in the first month?
options: The landlord gave the wrong bank details.
The writer could not open a bank account in time.
The writer forgot the payment date.
questions.explain: 未完成地址登記就無法開銀行帳戶，因此第一個月房租遲繳，選 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 都是看似合理但文中沒有的原因。

questions.prompt: What does the writer advise future exchange students to do?
options: Make official appointments before leaving home
Take more courses with small tasks
Avoid asking local students for help
Learn German for at least two years
questions.explain: 建議 book official appointments before you leave home，選 (A)。(B) 作者建議把每門課當成長期專案，而非許多小任務；(C) 與「別怕向當地學生求助」相反；(D) 未提到。

reading.title: Campus Shuttle Service: Spring Semester Update
passage: Starting February 17, the university will run a new shuttle route connecting the main campus, the Medical Campus, and Riverside MRT Station. The service is free for anyone with a valid student or staff ID. Visitors may ride for NT$15 per trip, paid by EasyCard only.

On weekdays, buses leave the Main Gate every 20 minutes during rush hours (7:00–9:00 and 17:00–19:00) and every 40 minutes at other times. On Saturdays, the service runs only once an hour, and there is no service on Sundays or national holidays.

Each bus has 30 seats and space for one wheelchair. Bikes are not allowed on board, but there are bike racks at every stop. Because of high demand last semester, the university has added an express bus that goes directly from the Main Gate to the Medical Campus without stopping at the Library stop. The express bus runs on weekday mornings only.

questions.prompt: Who must pay to ride the shuttle?
questions.explain: 持學生證或教職員證者免費，訪客每趟 NT$15，選 (C)。(A)(B) 持證即免費；(D) 輪椅只提到車上有空間，與收費無關。

questions.prompt: How often do buses leave the Main Gate at 11 a.m. on a weekday?
questions.explain: 上午十一點不在尖峰時段（7–9 點、17–19 點），平日非尖峰每 40 分鐘一班，選 (B)。(A) 是尖峰班距；(C) 是週六班距；(D) 是週日。

questions.prompt: A student arrives at the Main Gate at 7:10 a.m. and must be at the Medical Campus by 7:40 a.m. Which bus should the student take?
questions.explain: 須同時看表格與文章：7:00 的車已開走；7:20 快車 7:32 到醫學院校區，趕得上；7:40 的車 8:00 才到，太晚，故選 (B)。

questions.prompt: What is true about the express bus?
options: It does not stop at the Library.
questions.explain: 文章說快車直達醫學院校區、不停圖書館站，表格中快車的 Library 欄也是「—」，選 (A)。(B) 快車只在平日早上行駛；(C) 所有公車都不能帶腳踏車上車；(D) 學生免費。

questions.prompt: What can passengers NOT do on the shuttle?
options: Get off at the Library stop
questions.explain: Bikes are not allowed on board，選 (D)。(A) 每車有一個輪椅空間；(B) 訪客正是用悠遊卡付費；(C) 一般班次會停圖書館站。
